newsitems.title: Toto’s Journey Is Coming to Steam on November 18!
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hey, everyone!We have some exciting news to share with you!After a long journey of development, countless little details to polish, and so much support from our community, we're happy to finally announce that Toto’s Journey will be released on November 18! 🎉Over the past few months, we've been working hard to bring Toto's adventure to life. We've shared glimpses of the magical world, introduced some of its inhabitants, and, most importantly, had the chance to hear your thoughts on the game.🧡️️️️️️With the demo now available, we've received lots of feedback from players who have explored the world through Toto's eyes. Your comments help us understand what you enjoy most, what needs more attention, and how we can make the journey even better.And we're not stopping here! We're continuing to polish the game and work on the details that make Toto's adventure feel special.In Toto's Journey, you'll get to:🐶 Explore a magical world inspired by The Wizard of Oz;🦴 Use Toto's natural abilities to sniff out secrets and discover hidden paths;🐸 Meet unusual inhabitants and help them along the way;🧩 Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and uncover the mysteries of the world;✨ Discover magical items and find new ways to explore.And, of course, experience the adventure through the eyes of a small but brave dog who's trying to find his way home.Thank you for playing the demo, sharing your feedback, and supporting Toto's Journey. We're happy to have you with us on this adventure, and we can't wait for you to experience the full game!Mark your calendars, and get ready to join Toto on his journey! 🐾

newsitems.title: When a Game Becomes More Than Just a Game
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: We’d like to share a story that touched our entire team.Far away in Chile, a girl named Fernanda grew up alongside a little dog named Vicente.He came into her life when she was six years old. For sixteen years, they were together, and Vicente was her loyal companion — fearless, devoted, and loved more than words can say.On September 27, Vicente passed away peacefully of old age, leaving behind a lifetime of memories.A few weeks later, Fernanda was scrolling through social media when an ad for a game caught her eye.She’d never heard of the game before. But the little dog on the screen looked remarkably like Vicente.It was our Toto.Fernanda told us that seeing him made her heart ache. It brought back the sadness of losing Vicente, but it also made her feel something special. She decided to track down our email address and share her friend’s story with us.She also told us that Toto’s Journey would now hold a very special place in her heart.Thousands of miles away, we were busy with our everyday work at a small game studio creating levels, fixing bugs, and preparing our game for release.We were making a game about a little dog who gets lost in a vast world and tries to find his way back to his owner.We never imagined that someone might look at Toto and see their own beloved friend — someone they wished was still by their side.Fernanda’s letter moved us deeply.We gathered at the office, displayed Vicente’s photo on the big screen, and took a team photo with a message dedicated to him:“Con todo nuestro cariño, para Vicente.”“With all our love, for Vicente.”Fernanda told us she had saved the photo and shared our letter with her family. She even said she dreams of meeting us someday.And then she wrote something we won’t forget:“In Chile, you’ll always have friends and family.”Just think - only a few days earlier, we were complete strangers.With Fernanda’s permission, we’re sharing her story with you.And we’ve decided that Vicente will have a small tribute in the final credits of Toto’s Journey. We never had the chance to meet him, but his story will now become a small part of ours.When we started making Toto’s Journey, we thought we were telling a story about a little dog trying to find his way home.Thanks to Fernanda, we’ve come to understand that a story like this can mean so much more. Sometimes, it can help someone feel close to a beloved friend they miss terribly, even if only for a moment.That’s something we never expected when we began making this game.And we’re incredibly grateful that Fernanda shared Vicente’s story with us.In memory of Vicente. A little dog with a big heart. 🤍

newsitems.title: Toto’s Journey: What to Expect From the Game
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Toto’s Journey: What Can Players Expect?As development on Toto’s Journey continues, we’ve been getting more and more questions about what the game will be like, when it will be released, and what players can expect from Toto’s journey.So we decided to gather some of the questions we get most often in one place and give you a clearer picture of what to expect from the game.When will Toto’s Journey be released?Toto’s Journey is planned to release in Q4 2026.We’ll announce the exact release date separately.Which platforms will the game be available on?We currently plan to release Toto’s Journey on:PC — SteamSteam DeckWill there be a console version?We’re currently exploring the possibility of bringing Toto’s Journey to consoles.We’ll share more details separately once we have more information to announce.Which engine is the game being developed in?Toto’s Journey is being developed using Unreal Engine 5.How long will the game take to complete?We currently expect a full playthrough to take around 5–6 hours.The actual playtime will depend on how you choose to play. You can focus on the main story and follow the main path, or take your time exploring every corner of the world, looking for secrets, collecting items and, of course, digging up anything that looks suspicious.We’re adding collectibles and hidden secrets to reward players who take the time to explore their surroundings.What is Toto’s Journey about?After being separated from Dorothy, Toto finds himself alone in an unfamiliar world and sets out to find his way home.The game is inspired by L. Frank Baum’s The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. You’ll find a few small references to the original story along the way, but Toto’s Journey is our own interpretation of this magical world rather than a direct adaptation of the book.What can you do as Toto?👃 Follow your nose Toto can pick up scents, discover hidden trails, find clues and notice things that might not be obvious at first glance.🕳️ Dig Some secrets and discoveries are hidden underground.🧩 Solve puzzles Progress through the world by exploring your surroundings, interacting with the environment and finding ways to overcome obstacles.✨ Gain new abilities As the journey continues, Toto will unlock new abilities that help him overcome obstacles and reach previously inaccessible areas.🌿 Explore the world Players will be able to discover hidden paths, secrets, collectibles and new areas throughout the journey.Who will Toto meet along the way?Toto will meet plenty of unusual characters and magical inhabitants during his journey.Some may help him with exploration, puzzles or getting further through the world, while others will simply become part of the journey and help Toto — and the player — discover more about this magical world.What kind of atmosphere can you expect?We wanted to create a warm and cozy atmosphere while still filling the game with exploration, puzzles and adventure.At the heart of the story is Toto’s desire to find his owner, Dorothy. Along the way, he’ll encounter new places, mysteries, challenges and plenty of unexpected encounters.It’s a story about a little dog setting out on a big journey home. Can I play Toto’s Journey before release?We’ll be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we’re planning to make the Toto’s Journey demo available to everyone in early October.So very soon, you’ll be able to meet Toto for yourself and take your first steps into his journey.See you at Steam Next Fest! 🐾

newsitems.title: Developer Diary #016: Turban of Winds
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!The dust from our second playtest has barely settled, and we’re already returning to our series about Magical Items — mysterious artifacts Toto may discover during his journey through the Magic Land.Today, we’d like to tell you about one of the most headstrong items in our collection — the Turban of Winds.Turban of Winds 🌪️Throughout its history, the Wind Sash has changed owners many times. Mostly because it tends to disappear whenever it gets bored.The Wind Sash is like the wind itself – it loves to be free and unrestrained, and it is whimsical like a summer breeze.It can’t stand staying in one place for too long, loves traveling and new experiences, and when it gets bored — it starts causing trouble.And perhaps it’s hard to imagine a better companion for it than a little dog traveling across the entire Magic Land himself.Faster Than the Wind For Toto, the Turban of Winds opens up new possibilities for movement.Using its power, Toto will be able to run faster and make quicker, more dynamic jumps, using the wind to overcome obstacles and reach places that were previously inaccessible.And most importantly, perhaps this power will finally help him get closer to the Hurricane that carried Dorothy away.We’ll tell you more about other Magical Items in future Developer Diaries.In the meantime, add Toto’s Journey to your Wishlist and stay tuned — Toto still has many unusual discoveries ahead!The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game.🪽 Follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube Instagram

newsitems.title: Developer Diary #015: What Changed After the Playtest
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!Toto is back — and wishes you a grrr-eat day! He’ll be setting off on another adventure soon — the next playtest is just around the corner!After our recent Toto’s Journey playtest, we carefully went through your feedback and continued improving some of the game’s core mechanics.Here’s what you can expect in the next version.Movement 🐛One of our main focuses has been making Toto feel better to control.We’ve improved the movement system, making running and jumping feel freer and more responsive.Just remember to watch where you’re going! 👀 A careless jump can still send Toto over the edge — which means it’s time to try again.Levitation and Small Objects 🦋We’ve also improved how Toto interacts with smaller objects that he can levitate.The whole process is now clearer and smoother: picking up, moving, and throwing objects requires fewer unnecessary actions and feels more intuitive.Heavy Obstacles 🪨Some objects are simply too heavy for Toto to pick up or drag around, but that doesn’t mean he can’t do anything about them.Certain obstacles can now be moved with a properly timed push, giving Toto another way to interact with the environment — and saving his teeth some work.What’s Next? 🐕There’s also one very obvious surprise we’ve added to the game.We won’t spoil it just yet — we’ll talk about it in one of our upcoming Developer Diaries. Thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest. Your feedback is helping us understand what works, what needs more attention, and how we can make Toto’s Journey even better. 🧡 Hope to see you on another journey!The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game.🌱 Follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube Instagram

newsitems.title: Dev Diary #013: The Bronze Seed
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!We’re continuing our series about Magical Things — mysterious artifacts that Toto will encounter during his journey through the Magic Land.Today, we’re taking a closer look at a tiny object with the power to transform an entire mountain.The Bronze SeedNo one knows where it came from. For a long time, it was considered almost harmless: the Bronze Seed helped flowers bloom and made crops grow bigger.But everything changed when it fell into the hands of a herbalist who lived high in the mountains.In just one month, the Seed transformed the entire mountain into a Bronze Forest. Living plants became intertwined with metal, their roots drawing strength from the surrounding earth, and metal vines continued to grow, destroying everything in their path.The forest could only be stopped with the help of the Bronze Bud, which grew from the Seed. As soon as the herbalist plucked it, the entire forest rusted and withered away.Since then, the Witches and Sorceresses of the Magic Land have kept a watchful eye on the Bronze Seed — either to make sure it never falls into the wrong hands… or because they secretly wanted it for themselves.For Toto, the Bronze Seed can be incredibly useful.As long as it stays away from the soil, Toto gains the ability to control plant roots and shoots. This allows him to make his way through dense vegetation, clear obstacles, and even venture through the thorniest bushes without fear.Just remember one thing: never plant the Bronze Seed near metal deposits. 👀Unless, of course, you’re hoping to grow another Bronze Forest.The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game.🌱 Follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube Instagram

newsitems.title: Dev Diary #013: Magical Items
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!In our previous developer diaries, we introduced you to the Magic Land, its inhabitants, and some of the places Toto will discover on his adventure.Toto is brave, loyal, and kind — but where do his magical abilities come from?The answer lies in the unusual discoveries he will come across along the way — the Magical Items. Each one grants Toto a unique power and unlocks new possibilities for exploration and puzzle-solving.These unusual artifacts will accompany Toto throughout his journey. Each carries a power of its own, granting him new abilities and revealing new ways to explore the Magic Land.One of these artifacts is the Star Pebble. Players who joined our playtest may already have an idea of what its magic can do. :)Long ago, a tiny shard of an enchanted star fell into the Land of Oz. Separated from the sky it once called home, it never stopped trying to return. Its power was so immense that, in one desperate attempt to escape the earth, the Pebble nearly lifted an entire mountain into the air.But eventually, it came to understandt that what drew it back was not homesickness, but the fear of being alone. In kind hands — or paws! — the Pebble grows calm and shares its power, temporarily weakening the pull of gravity.With the Star Pebble’s help, Toto can open new paths, reach inaccessible areas, and solve unusual puzzles during his adventure.More magical artifacts will be revealed in our upcoming developer diaries. ✨The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game.👒 Follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube Instagram

newsitems.title: Dev Diaries #012: Voices of the Swamps
newsitems.author: a.limonova
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!We’re back with another look at the world of Toto’s Journey and the creatures who call the Magic Land their home.Throughout his adventure, Toto will meet many different inhabitants of the Blue Country. Some live among forests and mountains, while others prefer less busy places hidden away from the common paths.The ones we’re introducing today prefer quiet swamps, cool shade, and peaceful life. And it seems they especially enjoy sharing their thoughts with friendly dogs who happen to pass by.Meet the Sage Toads!Each Sage Toad has experienced many things in their years of life in the Magic Land and holds vast amounts of knowledge and wisdom like few in all Four Countries have. And since their fellow Toads already know most of their tales, they are always happy to share them with a new traveler.So if Toto politely asks, they’ll gladly offer a helpful hint or a bit of swampy wisdom. They are quite friendly, after all.The Toads also have one very special tradition — somehow, their most important conversations always happen on Wednesdays. Perhaps it’s a coincidence… or perhaps they simply know that Wednesdays are when we share new developer diaries about Toto’s adventure.Toadally by coincidence or not, many more secrets and stories from the Magic Land are still waiting ahead!The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game.🐸 Follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube Instagram

newsitems.title: Dev Diary #011: Digging in!
newsitems.author: addvans
newsitems.contents: Hello, players!We are back with another update on Toto's Journey! Our team is hard at work filling the game world with exciting details, and today we'd like to share more about how our brave dog interacts with his surroundings. In our previous posts, we showed you the environmental diversity of the Magic Land, from deep forests to mysterious caves. While exploring these biomes, Toto can peek into every corner and sniff out hidden secrets. However, sometimes a simple sniff isn't enough, and to find what he's looking for, Toto literally has to get his paws dirty. Often, an interesting item, a hidden passage, or a forgotten secret is concealed right under the surface. To uncover these mysteries, our four-legged adventurer has to literally dig to the truth! As we build and refine the game's levels, we are carefully placing specific spots where the earth is loose enough for Toto to dig. You'll need to keep a close eye out for these areas during your adventure. But what exactly lies beneath the soil? That part is up to you to find out! It could be a new pathway leading further into the underground, an unusual item, or who knows what else! We can't wait for you to uncover all the secrets of the Magic Land. Let us know in the comments what kind of treasures you hope to dig up! The best way to support Toto's Journey right now is to Wishlist the game: And follow us on social media: DiscordXYouTube
